exposure: Aggressive angiomyxoma (AA) of the vulva in a pregnant female
outcome: Delivery of baby by caesarean section
cohort: A 25-year-old 32-week primigravida patient presenting with a large pedunculated Aggressive angiomyxoma (AA) arising from the left side of the vulval area.
finding: Successful complete excision of the vulval aggressive angiomyxoma was achieved without recurrence even after two and a half years follow-up, following delivery of the baby by caesarean section.
mod_finding: The baby was delivered by caesarean section prior to tumour excision.
